statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-5160 (GHSA-c97m-vxhj-p7j6, GO-2026-5320): goldmark's HTML renderer checked link destinations for dangerous URL schemes such as javascript: before resolving HTML character references, so a scheme written with a named character reference in place of the colon passed the check, allowing cross-site scripting in applications that render untrusted Markdown. It affects github.com/yuin/goldmark before 1.7.17; the Go vulnerability database lists Renderer.renderAutoLink, Renderer.renderImage and Renderer.renderLink in renderer/html. Upstream fixed it in commit cb46bbc4 (https://github.com/yuin/goldmark/commit/cb46bbc4eca29d55aa9721e04ad207c23ccc44f9, released in v1.7.17), which escapes the URL before the IsDangerousURL check and adds that check to auto-links. Sources: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-c97m-vxhj-p7j6 and https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5320. We checked every scout-sbom-indexer-dev package published for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository as of 27 November 2026: 25 builds, 1.20.4-r1 to the current 1.30.0-r0, on x86_64 and aarch64 (50 packages). Each package holds one file, /sbom-indexer, a statically linked Go program for Linux built with CGO_ENABLED=0 (no program interpreter and no shared-library dependencies). We read the program in full from every package, except 1.26.0-r3, whose program has the same SHA-1 checksum, recorded in its package header, as the 1.26.0-r2 program we read. The -dev program is built without the -w linker flag and without -trimpath; its Go release and module versions are the same as those of the scout-sbom-indexer program of the same build. Its Go build information lists github.com/yuin/goldmark, with no replacement and the same on both architectures: v1.7.13 in 1.20.4-r1 to 1.23.1-r0, v1.7.17 in 1.23.1-r1 to 1.30.0-r0. Reading the program's Go function table in every build (runtime.main found in every build as a control) shows goldmark's renderer/html functions renderAutoLink, renderLink and renderImage linked in every build. In the disassembly of renderAutoLink, every build from 1.23.1-r1 on, which carry v1.7.17, calls IsDangerousURL, the check the fix adds to auto-links, and no earlier build does. So the earlier builds are affected, and 1.23.1-r1 is the first fixed build.

Upstream fixed it in commit cb46bbc4 (https://github.com/yuin/goldmark/commit/cb46bbc4eca29d55aa9721e04ad207c23ccc44f9, released in v1.7.17), which escapes the URL before the IsDangerousURL check and adds that check to auto-links. Sources: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-c97m-vxhj-p7j6 and https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5320. We checked every scout-sbom-indexer package published for Alpine 3.24 in the DHI Alpine repository as of 27 November 2026: 20 builds, 1.21.0-r0 to the current 1.30.0-r0, on x86_64 and aarch64 (40 packages). Each package holds one file, /sbom-indexer, a statically linked Go program for Linux built with CGO_ENABLED=0 (no program interpreter and no shared-library dependencies). We did not unpack these packages: the SHA-1 checksum of /sbom-indexer recorded in each package's header equals that of the program we read in full from the Alpine 3.23 package of the same version, revision and architecture (for 1.26.0-r3, the 1.26.0-r2 program, which has the same checksum), so these packages carry the same programs. Its Go build information lists github.com/yuin/goldmark, with no replacement and the same on both architectures: v1.7.13 in 1.21.0-r0 to 1.23.1-r0, v1.7.17 in 1.23.1-r1 to 1.30.0-r0. Reading the program's Go function table in every build (runtime.main found in every build as a control) shows goldmark's renderer/html functions renderAutoLink, renderLink and renderImage linked in every build. In the disassembly of renderAutoLink, every build from 1.23.1-r1 on, which carry v1.7.17, calls IsDangerousURL, the check the fix adds to auto-links, and no earlier build does. So the earlier builds are affected, and 1.23.1-r1 is the first fixed build.

Sources: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-c97m-vxhj-p7j6 and https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5320. The md5sums manifest in each package's control archive lists a single file, /opt/docker/config/scout-sbom-indexer.yaml, whose MD5 checksum is that of the 180-byte YAML configuration file shipped in the Alpine packages (it sets SBOM cataloger options for the image); we also unpacked 1.29.0-1 for arm64 in full and found only that file. It contains no program, library or Go code, so goldmark is not part of this package. The program ships in the scout-sbom-indexer and scout-sbom-indexer-dev packages, which have their own decisions.
